name: @dreamfactory/jumpraven
description: Jump Raven (1994) — CyberFlix's second game, a hovercraft shooter over a drowned New York, on the same DreamFactory 0 as Lunicus. Ported from RAVEN.EXE by disassembly, the whole game plays — the story's briefings, the shop, the repair bay, the copilots and the three days' flying and bosses, to the pilot's ending — with saved games (.RVN) through the shared dialog, and ?autoplay to watch it play itself.
